subject: CryptoPkg: add CAMELLIA APIs for TCG TPM reference library
reasons: This is a new API addition (adding CAMELLIA wrapper functions), not a transformation of existing code
Adding new functions, structs, and PCD entries across multiple files cannot be expressed as a Coccinelle match-and-replace rule
While it is part of a series of TPM-related API additions, each commit adds a different new cipher API which requires new code, not transforming existing patterns
Coccinelle cannot generate new code where none existed before
